economy.summary: Kelly's campaign platform calls for removing regulations he says stifle private sector investment and hamper job creation, stating that businesses, not the government, create jobs.
economy.short: Supports removing regulations he says hamper private-sector job creation.

taxes.summary: Kelly states the tax code should be simpler and taxes should be lower, with revenue growth coming from more jobs rather than higher rates. As a Ways and Means member he supported the 2025 bill extending the 2017 tax cuts, including no tax on tips or overtime.
taxes.short: Supports simpler tax code, lower rates; voted to extend 2017 tax cuts.

abortion.summary: Kelly reintroduced the Heartbeat Protection Act, which would prohibit abortion once a fetal heartbeat is detected, and has voted against the Women's Health Protection Act, which would have codified federal abortion access.
abortion.short: Proposes prohibiting abortion after detectable heartbeat; opposes codifying abortion access.

education.summary: Kelly's platform says local communities need adequate funding and flexibility in education, and supports accountability and expanding parental choice, including career and technical education alongside traditional college paths.
education.short: Supports local flexibility, parental choice, career and technical education.

healthcare.summary: Kelly authored the Protecting Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act to limit prior-authorization delays in Medicare, leads the Treat and Reduce Obesity Act to expand Medicare coverage of weight-management treatment, and says he works to protect Medicare's solvency.
healthcare.short: Proposes limiting Medicare prior-authorization delays; supports protecting Medicare.

energy.summary: Kelly supports an all-of-the-above energy approach using coal, natural gas, nuclear, biofuels, oil, solar, and wind to pursue American energy independence.
energy.short: Supports all-of-the-above energy strategy for American energy independence.

guns.summary: Kelly describes himself as a strong believer in the Second Amendment, stating it protects law-abiding citizens from government infringement on the right to keep and bear arms.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment rights; opposes government infringement on gun ownership.

economy.summary: Wagner says working families face an affordability crisis and proposes raising the federal minimum wage and tying it to inflation so workers do not lose buying power.
economy.short: Proposes raising federal minimum wage and indexing it to inflation.

taxes.summary: Wagner opposes the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, which he calls a transfer of wealth to billionaires, and supports restoring higher tax rates on the wealthy and closing loopholes to fund infrastructure and jobs.
taxes.short: Opposes 2017 tax law; supports higher taxes on wealthy, closing loopholes.

abortion.summary: Wagner supports codifying Roe v. Wade through the Women's Health Protection Act, passing the Right to Contraception Act, ending the Hyde Amendment, expanding Title X funding, and repealing the Comstock Act.
abortion.short: Supports codifying Roe, contraception protections, ending Hyde Amendment.

education.summary: Wagner's campaign says he will work to ensure every school has the tools it needs to prepare the next generation; his site does not detail specific education policy proposals.
education.short: Supports ensuring schools have tools needed; no detailed proposals stated.

healthcare.summary: Wagner supports Medicare for All so every American can get treatment without fear of financial ruin, and opposes cuts to Medicare and Medicaid, pledging to strengthen both programs.
healthcare.short: Supports Medicare for All; opposes Medicare and Medicaid cuts.

energy.summary: Wagner proposes cutting emissions and investing in clean energy jobs, and supports strengthening the Clean Air Act and Clean Water Act with tougher enforcement against polluters.
energy.short: Proposes cutting emissions, clean energy jobs, stronger environmental enforcement.
